title: A Parish for the Portrait
author: Zephyrine Ishikawa
blurb: Vesper Eastwick, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
